title: Witch on Ghost Ship
description: A vibrant pink-haired witch in a blue hat and black dress stands on the bow of a decaying ghost ship during a stormy night. She holds a glowing jack-o'-lantern staff as lightning cracks across the dark sky, surrounded by swirling ghosts, floating pumpkins, and eerie green energy over turbulent waters with a haunted castle in the background.
prompt: A beautiful pink-haired witch with pale skin wearing a large blue witch hat, black and white dress with orange stockings stands dramatically on the bow of an old wooden ghost pirate ship in a turbulent stormy sea at night. She holds a tall staff topped with a glowing carved jack-o-lantern emitting blue lightning. The dark sky is filled with dramatic lightning bolts and swirling white and pink ghostly spirits. Several glowing jack-o-lanterns and white ghosts float around the ship. A haunted castle is visible on the distant shore. Highly detailed fantasy scene with dramatic lighting and vibrant colors.
